The trigger is the token form itself: the standalone word ' head' in every sense (body part, head of a department, 'head north', 'on its head') and ' heading'/' heads' are strongest, and the same class covers a scattered lexical set of a few hundred single-token English open-class word forms read at about 0.3-0.8 ('hook', 'grid', 'atmosphere', 'person', 'chair', 'mayor', 'observer', 'king', 'president', 'section', 'significant', 'important', 'main', 'subsequent', 'however', 'previously', 'approximately', 'located', 'represent', 'separate', 'otherwise') plus many word-internal BPE pieces (including Greek and Devanagari byte fragments, which is why those languages read active); the same morpheme fused inside a larger token ('ahead', 'header', 'headline', 'headquarters', 'forehead', 'overhead'), semantically related words ('neck', 'skull', 'face', 'chief', 'director', 'queen', 'large', 'different', 'following'), the highest-frequency function words, and common concrete or topical nouns ('market', 'company', 'family', 'child', 'school', 'team', 'film', 'doctor') read inactive.

A local trust now maintains the towpath, and walkers follow it for fifteen miles between the two towns.
